name: PagedAttention
question: Why do LLM servers leave most of their GPU memory empty, and how does paging fix it?
problem: A server can't know how long a reply will be, so it reserves a worst-case block of GPU memory for every request. 60 to 80% of it sits empty.
points: Split the KV cache into fixed pages of 16 tokens.
A page table maps each request's tokens to pages anywhere in GPU memory, allocated as the reply grows.
Waste drops under 4%, so more requests fit in a batch: 2 to 4x throughput on the same GPU.
title: How vLLM and PagedAttention Fixed LLM Memory Waste #shorts
